description: Land Acquisition - Attidiya, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically revokes a previous order related to the vesting of a particular land parcel in the state, provides detailed land descriptions including boundaries, extent (0.1716 Hectare), location (Attidiya South, Ratmalana, Colombo District), and survey details. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
